newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: SAirGroup takes '96 charges of 739 mln Sfr.
newsitem.headline: SAirGroup takes '96 charges of 739 mln Sfr.

text.p: SAirGroup, which on April 4 announced a 1996 net loss of 497 million Swiss francs, has booked extraordinary charges totalling 739 million francs in its 1996 results.

SAirGroup's 1996 annual report listed extraordinary income of 41 million francs and extraordinary charges of 739 million, resulting in an extraordinary loss of 698 million compared with an extraordinary loss of 342 million in 1995.

SAirGroup said in the notes to its group result that the extraordinary charges include 267 million francs to fully write down the value of its 49.5 percent stake in Belgian carrier Sabena SA and 300 million for future structural adjustment to the full liberalisation of the European air transport market from April 1.
These two charges were also announced on April 4, but not the remaining charges totalling 172 million francs.
SAirGroup also took provisions in 1996 to "further depreciate goodwill, for existing environment-related liabilitiies, for lease-related hedges and for cargo-related business."
